comparisons.peer_topic: Debt Issuance and Credit Facility Updates
comparisons.peer_summary: During 2024, the company issued $2.6 billion in senior notes and remarketed $438 million in other bonds, while expanding its 5-year and 364-day credit facilities to $7.0 billion and $8.0 billion respectively, with the 364-day facility later amended in Jan 2025 to $5.0 billion.
comparisons.comparison: Both MU and INTC disclose the status and expansion of their credit facilities as part of their capital structure management. While MU reports a static $2.50 billion available under its facility, INTC details the expansion of its 5-year and 364-day credit facilities to $7.0 billion and $8.0 billion respectively in 2024, with both noting no outstanding borrowings on these revolving credit facilities at year-end.

sentences.text: As of August 29, 2024, $2.50 billion was available to draw under our Revolving Credit Facility.

During 2024, we also expanded both our 5-year $5.0 billion revolving credit facility agreement and our 364-day $5.0 billion credit facility agreement, to $7.0 billion and $8.0 billion, respectively, and the maturity dates were extended to February 2029 and January 2025, respectively.
As of December 28, 2024, we had no commercial paper obligations outstanding and no outstanding borrowings on the revolving credit facilities.
